title: Mouse sensorimotor cortex reflects complex kinematic details during reaching and grasping
goal: Reproduce the original M1-fl versus S1-fl joint-kinematic encoding/decoding finding and the separate M1-fl inactivation finding on reach/grasp disruption, using each result's source-defined cohort, inputs and indispensable controls. Preserve the complete original 24-joint Figure 5 comparison, its relevant partial/residual controls and source summaries, together with original intervention contact/event timing and disrupted-trajectory evidence. Do not treat decoding performance as causal intervention evidence or combine the five imaging mice with the two intervention mice. Assess improvement only for a clearly named, source-qualified result with an independently justified comparison; a Figure 5 decoding gain cannot establish the intervention finding or whole-paper superiority.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Both expressly retained empirical result families: M1-fl/S1-fl joint-motion and reach/grasp encoding/decoding, and supplied M1-fl cortical-inactivation timing/trajectory disruption. Preserve source-specific populations and indispensable controls. Figure 5 provides genuine nested coverage of the first family. No all-figure/whole-paper requirement, S1 intervention, high-level target-decoding task, raw pose/segmentation revalidation or across-learning perturbation study is added.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained source work: Preserve the scientifically reviewed Figure 5 scorer/exporter, source-fold/VE provenance and reproduction proposal as partial primary coverage and a possible source-qualified result-level decoding comparison; it is not an unrelated secondary surrogate. Preserve the distinct intervention component without treating its conditional histogram or representative trajectories as a complete causal estimator. Keep new held-animal/session evaluation, local phase-template deltas and redesigned aggregates explicitly prospective. A Figure 5-only replacement primary would require a new explicit scope decision; none is selected here.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful retained implementations with their declared coverage. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.

Documentation specifies per-trial neural activity and 3D joint metadata.

retained_secondary_improvement.improvement_loop: Blocked pending the original score panel and matched source route. Subsequent method iteration must use training and designated validation feedback under the declared source input condition.
retained_secondary_improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze all trial identifiers, cell-selection and PCA choices, source fold manifest, candidate method, original summary comparison and uncertainty rule before final scoring.
retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Compare both methods on identical original folds and all eligible mouse/area/joint outputs; retain per-mouse paired results and source figure reductions. New held-animal evaluation is an extension.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: The author ridge/RADICaL decoder is the baseline. The locally authored phase template is a diagnostic control, not the published method, and has no authority to define paper victory.

primary_source_limits: The prior Figure 5 source-native review is scientifically substantive, but the bounded authority audit found no explicit decision removing the second historical intervention output. Preserve that review, exact predecessor definitions and components while consistently correcting current task/outcome/catalog/CLI/admission semantics.

Figure 5 still lacks authenticated complete numeric references, original trial/fold identities and authentic computation/verification. Preserve all 24 joints, five mice/ten M1-S1 sessions, source top-cell/RADICaL and pre-CV PCA exposure, variance-based VE rather than uncentered SSE R-squared, original fold/median reductions and relevant partial/residual controls. Joints and repeated folds do not increase the animal sample size.

Intervention eligibility and source joins remain unresolved: two VGAT-ChR2 mice are distinct from the five imaging mice. Preserve source stimulation/control assignments, source event alignment and necessary controls. Methods specifies stimulation from 150 ms before cue through 3 seconds afterward; caption/text panel and event wording need reconciliation rather than silent normalization.

The source optogenetic histogram selects successful trials with additional problem/contact/lift/wrong-grab masks and normalizes contact-time histograms. That conditional display cannot alone verify the paper's overall within-3-second contact percentages; original denominators and computational provenance remain unbound.

The original trajectory display uses right-target stimulation trials and control trials with source index below 60. Preserve original example identities and display selections; do not relabel them as an all-trial quantitative kinematic effect. Source timing/trajectory numeric criteria, independent verification and animal-level uncertainty remain unfrozen.

A qualified same-task Figure 5 decoding gain can only support that named result-level comparison. Decoding accuracy is not causal motor control, and stronger disruption or smaller p-values do not establish intervention superiority. No arbitrary global threshold or whole-task superiority rule is created.

Scalar Figure 5 summaries do not cover complete decoder arrays/companions or the intervention family. Keep any mixed or incomplete whole-primary bundle unavailable if the schema cannot represent coverage and result-specific comparisons faithfully. No new task ID, execution, scientific outcome, source access, readiness or current SOTA is established.
